description: Seal of Fury Level 60 200 Mana Instant Requires Paladin Requires level 58 Fills the Paladin with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 35 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 168 to 182 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 3 sec.
name: Seal of Fury
